messages.subject: Error in MSStatsTMT proteinSummarization
parts:
Hi I am working with this TMT dataset and I am trying to run the proteinSummarization function as:
quant.msstats <- proteinSummarization(
    small.input.sm,
    method = "msstats",
    global_norm = TRUE, 
    reference_norm = FALSE,
    remove_norm_channel = TRUE, 
    remove_empty_channel = TRUE
  )

However, I get the following error after the las Run summarization is finished:

Error in `[.data.table`(processed, , `:=`(c("PeptideSequence", "Charge"),  : 
  Supplied 2 columns to be assigned 4 items. Please see NEWS for v1.12.2.
